comment: Pinned public designs used for robustness/performance/regression runs. Sources are NOT vendored: scripts/run_public_projects.sh clones them at the pinned commit into a scratch directory. Upstream RTL is not assumed defect-free and sverity findings are not assumed to be true bugs (RFC section 7). 'expect' only asserts that the run completes, with the stated execution status; it is not a statement about design quality.
